$comment: The ONE file in qf-atlas a human edits by hand. Everything else is generated.
Maps a finding id (from atlas.json) to what you decided about it.
Anything not listed here counts as 'undecided'.
repair    real, scheduled -> becomes a work order
remove    confirmed dead -> becomes a deletion batch
accepted  known debt you are living with. REQUIRES why, owner and expires,
or it does not count as a decision and stays undecided.
All clear means undecided == 0. It does not mean zero findings: some coverage
gaps are unparseable without a compiler, and some debt is deliberate.
Ids are semantic, so they survive edits inside a file. Renaming a file or
moving the SQL retires the old id and raises a fresh undecided one, which is
correct: code that moved deserves another look.
